description: Fetches basic company profile information from LinkedIn company pages, handling geo-restrictions, authentication requirements, and bot detection gracefully.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_company_info   获取LinkedIn公司页面信息，需要url或slug参数
  - extract_slug       从LinkedIn URL中提取公司slug

slug.description: LinkedIn公司标识符/短名称 (用于get_company_info，可替代url参数)
